summary: Pacing night for Disaster Desk. I added two Short topics that break the air/bridge/ship block (Deepwater Horizon, now the top usable topic, and the Taum Sauk reservoir). I also added one motion challenger: fast hook, then held shots with a live instrument.
why: Air, bridge and ship are blocked for the next Shorts. Deepwater Horizon Shorts break out at 172x and 41x their channels' size, and the CSB report gives 6 figures. Taum Sauk has a 340K Short (2.3x) and an 11.5M long video, and nobody died. Our Shorts change shot size every ~1.6 s all the way through, while the 1.9M-7.4M references cut fast in the hook and then hold 5-25 s shots.

findings.title: Deepwater Horizon Short breakout: 338K on a 1.97K channel
findings.detail: The CSB found that buckled pipe kept the blowout preventer's blade from sealing the well. Figures: 11 killed, 17 injured, 115 evacuated, a reported 4M barrels.

findings.title: Taum Sauk: a mountaintop reservoir overfilled, nobody died
findings.detail: USGS gives 1.5 billion gallons and a 680-ft breach. A 340K Short on 151K subs; Practical Engineering's long video has 11.5M.

findings.title: Our Shorts cut at one even rhythm
findings.detail: 27-33 shot-size changes in 46-49 s, about one every 1.6 s. Athena (7.4M) cuts ~10 times in 10 s, then holds 5-7 s; Inside Decoded and World explained hold long shots with a live instrument. Challenger dd-hold-after-hook.

findings.title: Learjet: still no NTSB preliminary report
findings.detail: The event is 24 days old, outside the fast lane. This week's 470K 'Look outside' Shorts quote the crew's radio, not a finding. Waiting for the report (~1 Dec).

findings.title: Challenger O-ring is a crowded lane

changes.title: 2 Short topics added, 1 category fixed
changes.detail: Deepwater Horizon (8.43, top usable) and Taum Sauk (6.93). The Hudson topic is set to air so the category block catches it.

changes.title: Challenger dd-hold-after-hook
changes.detail: Look kind, motion, judged on held after the hook: fast hook, then 4-6 s held shots with a ticking instrument.
